DeletionScope.deletedTitle: Deleted immediately when you delete your account
deleted: Your account: login identity (Google / LINE / Apple account ID), name, email, profile photo URL, and your settings such as join name, default level and avatar
Your push notification subscriptions (Web Push and the iOS app's push token)
Signups not yet approved by a group leader, and family members not yet approved
The login state on this device, plus the per-session identities and notification history this app keeps on the device; any other device still logged in to this account is signed out too
retained: In sessions where you were approved, your name (and those of family members you brought) stays in that group's roster and game logs (level, games played, minutes, paid flag) as the group leader's session records. After deletion they're no longer linked to your account, and the avatar and signup message are removed
Group leaders' action logs (which may mention the name you used in a session) are deleted automatically after 90 days
Feedback you sent is kept for the developer but anonymized: your name, email and account ID are removed
DeletionScope.leaderNote: Group leader (host console) accounts aren't deleted here: request deletion through the in-app "💬 Feedback" or the developer email on the Google Play / App Store listing.
